MispIntegration.description: One `[[misp]]` block: a MISP instance objects are shared to.

name.description: Block name: 1 to 64 lowercase letters, digits, hyphens or underscores. A later layer restating it overrides this block key by key.
name.title: Name

url.description: Base URL of the MISP instance (http or https).
url.title: Url

api_key.description: MISP automation key. Write a ${NAME} reference to an environment variable; a literal key is reported as a warning.
api_key.title: Api Key

max_tlp.description: Highest tlp an object may carry and still be shared here. There is no default.
max_tlp.title: Max Tlp

object_types.description: Object families shared to this instance.
object_types.title: Object Types

rule_statuses.description: Deployment statuses a rule must have to be shared. Names from deployment.toml.
rule_statuses.title: Rule Statuses

organisation_uuid.description: UUID of the MISP organisation the events are created for. Omit to use the object's organisation.
organisation_uuid.title: Organisation Uuid

additionalProperties.description: Unknown connector: skipped with a warning.

description: Merged `sharing.toml`. Top-level keys are connector arrays; `[[misp]]` is the only one.
title: sharing.toml
